objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to lifecycle control including creation, release, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation with consecutive number (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_extension_period
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be re-checked (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and has no own release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently without affecting document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expiration requiring a decision on continued validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in one or more roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization and distribution assignment.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The set of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that orchestrates the steps of a release, validity extension, override, or reactivation process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant documenting their completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was applied (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type used when creating new documents.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the template.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Office format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata or attributes of a document are maintained or changed in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: sign_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer signs the review step confirming technical or formal check with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical or formal review.

evts.name: sign_release_step
evts.description: A releaser signs the release step approving the document for distribution.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is officially released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all previous data.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment that is no longer relevant for the new version is marked for archiving.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) processes the validity extension request via workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow (releaser-only or initiator-reviewer-releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except archive group are revoked and archiving begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the released document via workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in that language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write permissions are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.
